lines.zh: 我迈着长腿，一步一步压过来
lines.en: I come on long legs, step by step.

lines.zh: 我背上有几道高高的棘
lines.en: High spines ridge my back.
Each step loosens the soil.

lines.zh: 我低着头走，鼻子离地很近
lines.en: Head low, my snout near the ground.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛蕨，没有踩碎它
lines.en: I round a fern without crushing it.

lines.zh: 我的身子比看着轻，可还是重
lines.en: Lighter than I look, and still heavy.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向走，没有改道
lines.en: I walk your way and do not change course.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过半人高的草
lines.en: My tail sweeps through waist-high grass.

lines.zh: 我从树影里走出来，又走进另一片
lines.en: I walk out of one shadow into another.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但从不后退
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never back up.

lines.zh: 我踩过一片水洼，水花溅起来
lines.en: I step through a puddle; water sprays.

lines.zh: 我停在坡上，看了看下面
lines.en: I halt on the slope and look below.

lines.zh: 我看到你了，脚步就变了
lines.en: I have seen you, and my gait changes.
I turn and come at you from the side.

lines.zh: 我站着，背上的棘对着天
lines.en: I stand, the spines on my back against the sky.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，把热气吐出去
lines.en: I open my mouth and let the heat out.

lines.zh: 我盯着那片树林的边缘
lines.en: I stare at the treeline.

lines.zh: 我的前肢很短，几乎用不上
lines.en: My forelimbs are short, almost useless.

lines.zh: 我在听，风里有别的味道
lines.en: I am listening; there is another smell on the wind.
My teeth are not long, but thick.

lines.zh: 我侧了侧头，眼珠跟着转
lines.en: I tilt my head, my eye tracking.

lines.zh: 我呼吸的时候，肋侧一张一合
lines.en: My flank swells and settles as I breathe.

lines.zh: 这片地界上的味道我都熟
lines.en: I know every smell in this range.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，赶走一只虫
lines.en: I shake my head at a biting fly.

lines.zh: 我的影子长得像一座桥
lines.en: My shadow stretches like a bridge.

lines.zh: 我不需要叫，叫会惊走东西
lines.en: I need not roar; it would scare things off.
I crouch slowly, then rise.
I scrape the ground with one foot.
I lower my head and face you.
You reach my chest.

lines.zh: 我不急，先看你敢不敢动
lines.en: I am in no hurry; let me see if you dare move.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我不认得
lines.en: I do not know what you hold.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一片空地
lines.en: An open patch lies between us.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，把重心往前
lines.en: I lower my body, weight forward.
You back away, and my head follows.

lines.zh: 我看你的腿，那是先要断的地方
lines.en: I watch your legs; those go first.
I make no cry; I just drop low
This ground is mine.
You took another step forward.
I open my mouth; the teeth are there.
I give half a step and growl low
That hit my flank.

lines.zh: 我没有叫，我只是转过来
lines.en: I did not cry out; I only turned.
Blood runs down to my legs.
One of my spines is bent.
I steady myself and lower again.
This wound makes me meaner.
I circle you, seeking a gap.
I shake my head to throw off the pain.
You will need a better plan.
I have smelled this many times
I take one step and stop.
That much will not fill my mouth.
Hold it still; do not tremble.
I stretch my head and reach.
Set it down and go; I will not follow.
I sniff; it smells good.
That much is only an appetizer.
Do not move while I bite.
When it is gone, I will still be watching you.
You slam in; I give half a step.
I am heavier; you are shoved off.

lines.zh: 这一撞把草压平了一片
lines.en: That flattened a patch of grass.
My spines rake your shoulder.
I turn to shed the force.

lines.zh: 两副身子撞上，闷闷一响
lines.en: Two bodies meet with a dull thud
My feet press pits into the soil.
I look down at you, very close.

lines.zh: 你没有退，这让我有点意外
lines.en: You did not retreat; that surprises me.
Try again, and it ends the same.

lines.zh: 我们互相绕着走，谁都不低头
lines.en: We circle each other; neither lowers its head.
First we compare size, then the rest.
The spines on my back are taller than its.

lines.zh: 我们一起猎，比一个猎得多
lines.en: Hunting together yields more than hunting alone.

lines.zh: 它的气味我认得，是这片林子的
lines.en: I know its scent; it is from this wood.

lines.zh: 我们不叫，叫会引来别的
lines.en: We stay silent; noise draws others.

lines.zh: 两具大身体挤过同一片蕨
lines.en: Two large bodies push through the same ferns.
It leads; I follow behind.
These eggs must be buried in the soil.

lines.zh: 这片地够我们两个，勉强
lines.en: This range holds us both, barely.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，猛地把头一甩
lines.en: I clamp down and whip my head up
This is heavier than it looks.
I pin it and tear slowly.
Too small to taste.
I snatch it up and toss it over my shoulder

lines.zh: 我咬着走了两步才放下
lines.en: I carry it two steps before dropping it.
The bone cracks under my teeth.

lines.zh: 这上面有别的动物的味道
lines.en: Another animal's scent is on this.
I do not eat what is already dead.
I drag it into the ferns, jaws closed on it
You moved, and my doubts are gone.
Three strides and I am there.
You are smaller, but I do not dismiss you.

lines.zh: 我把身子一沉，脚下生风
lines.en: I drop my body and pick up speed
The spines on my back lift a little.
The slope is behind you; you cannot run fast.

lines.zh: 风把你身上的味道送过来
lines.en: The wind carries your smell to me.
I take you into my sight.
I do not roar; I charge.
This one is mine
I will not come away empty.

lines.zh: 我记下你每一步的落点
lines.en: I mark where each of your steps lands

lines.zh: 你退得太慢，我追得上来
lines.en: You retreat too slowly; I can close the gap
Ten paces left between us.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，脚步压得很低
lines.en: I track you, my steps kept low.

lines.zh: 你绕树，我也绕，绕得更外
lines.en: You circle the tree; I circle wider
My head stays turned to you.
You cannot outrun me, nor hide.
I wait for you to stumble.

lines.zh: 这一片林子我熟得闭眼都走
lines.en: I know this wood blindfolded.
My shadow falls on you.
The more you bolt, the tighter I track you
I am counting your remaining steps.
The trees end; open ground ahead

lines.zh: 我停了一下，让你以为有机会
lines.en: I pause to let you think you have a chance.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很沉，脚步没乱
lines.en: My breathing is heavy; my steps are not.
You hug the cliff; that is perfect.
For the last stretch, I run.
You look up at me too late.
I bite down, teeth clashing.
I swing my whole head.
My foreclaw lands on your shoulder.
The charge knocks you back.

lines.zh: 我背上的棘划开了你的衣服
lines.en: My back spines tear your clothing.
You are pinned against the slope.
I bite and whip my head.
That used the strength of my hips.

lines.zh: 低吼在喉咙里炸成咆哮
lines.en: The growl in my throat breaks into a roar
You are still standing; good.
I step back and study you again.
The second bite is more precise.

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫，抽中你的膝弯
lines.en: My tail sweeps and catches the back of your knee
I lower my head, teeth close.

lines.zh: 林子深处传来沉重的脚步
lines.en: Heavy steps sound from deep in the wood.

lines.zh: 我从树影里出来，背上的棘先露
lines.en: I emerge from shadow, back spines first.

lines.zh: 这片地是牛津黏土的样子
lines.en: This ground looks like the Oxford Clay.

lines.zh: 我踩下的第一脚，蕨都倒了
lines.en: My first step flattens the ferns.

lines.zh: 风里有一股没闻过的味道
lines.en: The wind carries a smell I do not know
A low call rolls across the ground.

lines.zh: 我先看了看树线，再往前走
lines.en: I check the treeline before moving on.
Not much prey here, but some.
My shadow lands on the grass first.

lines.zh: 我从坡上下来，速度快了
lines.en: I come down the slope, faster now.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，比周围的树矮不了多少
lines.en: I raise my head, close to the trees' height.
I have not walked this ground.

lines.zh: 我停在空地边上，先看了一圈
lines.en: I stop at the clearing's edge and scan.
The wind comes from behind me; good.
I turn my body half around.
I lower my head; there are prints in the dirt.
I plant myself facing the tree shadows.
I start walking again.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背棘，我大步冲开
lines.en: Fire catches my back spines; I charge clear.

lines.zh: 我从坡上摔下去，翻了半圈
lines.en: I fall down the slope and roll.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我猛抬头
lines.en: Water fills my snout; I jerk my head up.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得侧移两步
lines.en: The blast shoves me two steps sideways.
An arrow lodges in my neck.
That force drops my legs heavy.
Hungry enough to bite bone.

lines.zh: 雷顺着背脊劈下，我绷直了
lines.en: Lightning runs down my spine and I lock stiff
No ground; I fall.
